name: Rock
description: A rock song: verses and choruses, a solo and a bridge, and a final double chorus. 96 bars.

sections.name: Intro
sections.tip: Open with the main riff or a drum fill, to set the tempo and the sound.

sections.name: Verse
sections.tip: Riff and rhythm section, with room for the vocal to tell the story.

sections.name: Chorus
sections.tip: Open up: bigger chords, crash cymbals and the line everyone sings.

sections.name: Verse
sections.tip: The same groove with something new: another guitar part, or heavier drums.

sections.name: Chorus
sections.tip: The chorus again, at least as big as the first.

sections.name: Solo
sections.tip: Let the lead guitar, or another instrument, take over the melody.

sections.name: Bridge
sections.tip: A change of chords or feel that builds the tension for the last chorus.

sections.name: Chorus
sections.tip: The last chorus, twice through: everything in, maybe up a key.

sections.name: Outro
sections.tip: End on the riff, on one big final chord, or with a fade.
